answer.answerText: No. ADR-043 provides identity and execution-mode constraints, but the specific ExecutionConfiguration refactor was caused by Story 0042's PAPER exit settlement and realized-PnL requirements.

claims.text: Story 0042 required extending PAPER settlement to compute realized PnL and explicitly identified TradingCalculatorService as the PnL implementation evidence.
The Story 0042 commit changed ExecutionConfiguration only to inject TradingCalculatorService into PaperSettlementService.
ADR-043 defines distinct financial and routing identities and mode-specific authority, but does not prescribe TradingCalculatorService injection or this configuration change.

evidence.excerpt: Extend or split PaperSettlementService so an EXIT validates the target again, applies the documented LONG/SHORT cash effects, computes realized PnL from entry basis and fill price, sets exit fields and CLOSED status, and saves the Account atomically.
Gross deterministic PnL | TradingCalculatorService.calculatePnL() | Focused tests passed
The Story 0042 commit adds a TradingCalculatorService parameter to the PaperSettlementService bean and passes it to the constructor.

Account.accountId is Trading Core financial account identity; BrokerAccount.id is execution and broker-routing identity; LIVE position authority is external and PAPER position authority is Trading Core.
The architecture must define distinct financial and execution identities, canonical durable relationship, mode-correct Risk Facts acquisition, and fail-closed behavior.
